'''Moussaka''' is a [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Bulgaria|Bulgarian]] minced meat dish, resembling a casserole. For the Greek version of this dish, see [[Cookbook:Greek_Moussaka|Greek Moussaka]]. This recipe is adapted from [http://www.roesing.net/recipes/moussaka.html Ralitsa Roesing's kitchen]. It's delicious with cold yogurt on the side.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]] for cooking
*1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] minced [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|meat]] (usually [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!)
*1 kg [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled and finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], finely chopped
*⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], finely chopped
*3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
*2 spoonfuls [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the onion and the minced meat in a little oil until the meat is cooked. The fattier the meat is, the less oil you need. 
#Combine meat and onions with the potatoes, tomatoes, and parsley. Add salt and pepper to taste.
#Transfer to a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes are cooked. 
#Stir the eggs, the yogurt and the flour together and pour it over the dish. Bake for 10 more minutes.
